export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (https://importkey.com/countries/india/siddharth-starch-private-limited): "2026-02-16 SIDDHARTH STARCH PRIVATE LIMITED BRENNTAG SOUTH AFRICA (PTY) LTD POTATO STARCH 8%- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Durban, S AFRICA 11081300 9726817" — i.e. real outbound shipment dated 2026-02-16, destination Durban (South Africa), HS 11081300, B/L 9726817. Second outbound record: "2026-02-11 SIDDHARTH STARCH PRIVATE LIMITED UNILEVER DE ARGENTINA S.A POTATO STARCH 9%- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Buenos Aires, Argentina 11081300 9588159" (B/L 9588159), plus a third on 2026-01-13 to Buenos Aires, Argentina, HS 11081300, B/L 8733216. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 85 Records detected", "Trading Partners 5", "Ports 7", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-21"; the visible table shows only 5 rows (3 export rows by this company + 2 import rows where it is the buyer). So 85 claimed vs 5 rows actually seen — the 85 figure is not independently verifiable from the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in the sources reachable. ImportKey lists the company as an Indian buyer of starch ("2026-02-21 ROQUETTE SINGAPORE PTE LTD. SIDDHARTH STARCH PRIVATE LIMITED ROQUETTE AMYLO MAIZE STARCH N-400 ... NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India 11081200 7673572"), which shows domestic import activity and a registered Indian address ("12 YASH APARTMENTS, MANAS LANE KALE PATH BHANDARKAR ROAD") but is not evidence of domestic supply. Volza and Eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403; web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so no GST/tender data could be retrieved.
note: Role: trader/importer-exporter of starches, not a manufacturer — the customs records show it buying starch from Roquette Singapore and reselling to South Africa and Argentina. Export side is factually confirmed with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (3 outbound records seen, Jan–Feb 2026, HS 11081300 potato starch). Declared HS codes 110813 and 350510: 110813 is directly corroborated by the shipment records; 350510 (dextrins/modified starches) does not appear in any of the 5 visible rows — not a ground for rejection, only a note that the second code is unconfirmed in the visible data. Domestic supply evidence: none found — no GST turnover, tender or contract data was publicly retrievable; recorded as unknown rather than declared_only because the company makes no supply claims that could be checked. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey does not publish values in the free view and no other source was reachable.
